mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the pointing test with two instruments was most worthwhile: the matching loss and recovery strengthened the finding while leaving shared errors and the cause open.

leastWorthwhile.text: The link from the halting problem to a fallible predictor felt broad; the result did not explain how that specific computational limit relates to the model.

surprise.text: Two agreeing instruments did not eliminate shared pointing errors or disturbances, a useful limit on the apparent confirmation.

arbitrary.text: Using the halting problem to reach the general claim that the model is not an oracle felt insufficiently motivated, although it was the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested in another chapter that tests predictions against observations and makes the remaining uncertainty as explicit as the instrument comparison did.
